// file_1
export class Users {
// ... elided ...
  find(req: Request): Promise<Row[]> {
    const name: string = req.params.name;
    const clean = name.trim();
    return this.db.query("SELECT * FROM users WHERE name = '" + clean + "'");
  }
}
